auction_title: NBA Auctions Weekly: The Playoff Push
title: Game Issued 2017 NBA Finals Ball
description_block: This ball was issued for the 2017 NBA Finals, when the Golden State Warriors faced the Cleveland Cavaliers. The Warriors defeated the Cavaliers in five games, capturing their fifth championship in franchise history. It marked the second NBA title for Stephen Curry, Klay Thompson, and Draymond Green, and the first with superstar Kevin Durant, who was named Finals MVP. The 2017 NBA Finals featured a rematch between the Golden State Warriors and the Cleveland Cavaliers for the third straight year. The Warriors won the series 4-1, capturing their second title in three years. With the addition of Kevin Durant, Golden State formed a dominant "super team" alongside Stephen Curry, Klay Thompson, and Draymond Green. Durant was named Finals MVP, averaging over 35 points per game and hitting clutch shots, including a memorable pull-up three in Game 3. Despite a strong effort from LeBron James—who averaged a triple-double for the series—the Cavaliers couldn't match the Warriors' firepower.

title: Tamar Bates ‘Canada Series’ Denver Nuggets 2025-2026 Game Worn Association Edition Jersey
description_block: This neutral ‘Association Edition’ jersey was worn by Tamar Bates on October 6, 2025, during the Canada Series in Vancouver, when the Denver Nuggets played the Toronto Raptors. Bates finished with 2 points, 1 assist, and 1 steal. The Nuggets beat the Raptors, 112-108. With a 6’3.75” frame, a 6’10.25” wingspan, and a smooth left-handed shooting stroke, Tamar Bates offers a blend of size and skill as a versatile scoring guard. Known for his ability to create shots off the dribble and stretch the floor, he projects as a reliable offensive weapon with secondary playmaking upside. He earned SEC Player of the Week honors after standout performances including a 29-point, 5-steal game versus No. 1 Kansas and captained Missouri in his senior year. Bates impressed at the NBA Draft Combine and G League Elite Camp with his shooting efficiency and length, making him an intriguing late second-round or two-way prospect. Blending size, scoring ability, and solid defensive tools, Bates projects as a capable combo guard with the potential to contribute as a 3-and-D role player and secondary ball-handler at the next level. This jersey has been photomatched by Sotheby’s Photomatching.
